text_block_list.text:
While searching for books in the library 
for some research—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Far from reaching my target time, I'm 
actually drifting further away.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My basic stamina is improving, so what 
else am I lacking...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Grass-cha~n! Sa~ve meee~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Eek... Urara-chan?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you startled me. Please keep it down 
in the library, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Though it's quite rare~. Seeing you in the 
library, Urara-chan.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You see, that short quiz we took 
the other day was super, super tough.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I did my best, but there were so many red 
X's, so now I have to do a retake.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And if my score is bad on the retake too, 
they said I'll get remedial classes...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, my training time is gonna 
get cut dowwwwn~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... That really is a problem~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, I was hoping you could teach me how to 
study, Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You always work so hard at training, 
Grass-chan, but your grades are amazing 
too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I wanna give it my all in running and 
studying just like you, Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that from such a hard worker like 
you makes me feel truly proud~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really? Ehehe, I'm so glad~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Shall we get started right away, 
then? Let's begin with the material 
covered in that quiz~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!? I forgot my stationery! Wait here, 
I'll go grab it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's no need to rush so much, take 
your time~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. That being said, I'll need to 
reschedule today's training session~.

Grass Wonder seemed to balance her 
training and study time quite well, but—

She looked somewhat exhausted. ...I 
decided to speak up to her.
choice_data_list: Are you pushing yourself too hard?
Are you pushing yourself too hard?

text_block_list.text:
She looked somewhat exhausted. ...I 
decided to speak up to her.
choice_data_list: Are you pushing yourself too hard?
Are you pushing yourself too hard?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. You overheard that just now~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...That is true. Now that you mention it, 
I suppose I haven't done anything to 
properly unwind lately.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even notice until you pointed it 
out. Could this be why my progress has 
stalled...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. I apologize, I was just talking to 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's just... telling Urara-chan not to 
rush was something I needed to hear 
myself, too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my? Were you listening in, by any 
chance~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I feel no different than usual... however.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's not good of me to look so worn out 
that those around me start worrying~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am not overdoing it, really~. I am quite 
fine, so please don't let it trouble you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...However, you make a fair point~. It is 
a big issue if I'm coming across that way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I deeply appreciate your concern~. Thanks 
to you, I was able to regain my 
composure~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan, sorry for the wait!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My... that was quick~, Urara-chan.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
'Cause if I didn't hurry, I'd have less 
time to spend with you, Grass-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm no good at studying, but... I'm sure 
it'll be lots of fun with you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. My schedule for this afternoon 
just happened to clear up~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... let us take it nice and easy, and do 
our best at a relaxed pace~♪
